notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed: driver.lock.json reviewed_by stays null and no hardware was attached or run. gym, pybullet and numpy were not importable where the gate ran, so fake.py is a pure-Python kinematic stand-in for PandaEnv and was not compared with the upstream environment; the sim backend (gym.make('panda-v0'), which also needs gym_panda imported so panda-v0 is registered) was not run. The fidelity contract describes the upstream PyBullet model (F1, timestep 1000/240 ms from README.md:65); its gaps disclose that the checked fake is kinematic, that the hand start pose and grasp rule are placeholders, that the upstream reset() cannot be seeded (so cap.world.seed.v1 affects only the fake), that render is not bound and that snapshot/restore is not offered. Only catalogue classes are used, so there are no catalogue requests. Expected warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the bridge keeps the seed and makes no native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT for the two seed inputs, ticks and action.values; there is no G4 warning. gate.digest is the digest the check printed (the report without its clock); check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
